entities.summary: Ivan Semyonovich Zhevakhov, also known as Ivane Simonis dze Javakhishvili was a Georgian nobleman and a general of the Imperial Russian Army. Zhevakhov is known for his participation in the Napoleonic Wars and the Russo-Turkish War (1787–1792) at the Siege of Ochakov (1789).
